tools.name: get_protected_content
tools.description: Demo of page-level (not just API-level) x402 protection. Returns a short confirmation message. Price: $0.001 per call.

tools.name: get_weather
tools.description: Live current weather conditions for any city (temperature, conditions, humidity, wind), sourced from Open-Meteo. Price: $0.001 per call.

city.description: City name, e.g. "Austin" (defaults to New York if omitted)

tools.name: generate_text
tools.description: Generates short text output for a prompt. Billed by output length, up to $0.05 max per call (x402 'upto' scheme — you authorize a ceiling, the actual charge is based on what's produced). Price: usage-based, max $0.05 per call.

prompt.description: Text prompt to generate insights about

tools.name: get_trend_insights
tools.description: Trend score, momentum, and related trends for a topic. Two tiers: standard ($0.001) returns a basic score, premium ($0.005) returns the full breakdown including related trends.

topic.description: Topic to fetch trend insights for

tools.name: ping_heartbeat
tools.description: Minimal heartbeat/ping endpoint, billed via a batch-settlement payment channel so it's cheap to call repeatedly in one session. Price: $0.001 per call.

tools.name: search_polymarket_markets
tools.description: Search or list active Polymarket prediction markets, ranked by 24h volume — question, outcomes, prices, volume, liquidity, end date. Price: $0.003 per call.

q.description: Optional keyword filter on the market question

tools.name: get_polymarket_market
tools.description: Full detail for a single Polymarket market by slug: prices, volume (24h/1wk/total), liquidity, resolution status. Price: $0.002 per call.

slug.description: Polymarket market slug (from the URL, or from search_polymarket_markets)

tools.name: search_kalshi_markets
tools.description: Search or list open Kalshi prediction markets (regulated US event contracts) — title, yes/no bid-ask, volume, close time. Price: $0.003 per call.

q.description: Optional keyword filter on the market title

tools.name: get_kalshi_market
tools.description: Full detail for a single Kalshi market by ticker: yes/no prices, volume, status, result. Price: $0.002 per call.

tools.name: find_prediction_market_divergence
tools.description: Finds prediction-market questions priced differently on Polymarket vs. Kalshi — a cross-platform divergence signal built from data no single-platform competitor has. Matches are keyword-overlap similarity, not a verified same-event guarantee; sanity-check a match before treating it as a real arbitrage signal. Price: $0.005 per call.

q.description: Optional keyword filter on the matched question text

tools.name: get_defi_protocol_tvl
tools.description: A DeFi protocol's current total value locked (TVL), broken out by chain, plus market cap. Data via DefiLlama. Price: $0.003 per call.

tools.name: rank_chains_by_defi_tvl
tools.description: Ranks blockchains by total DeFi value locked across all protocols. Price: $0.002 per call.

limit.description: Number of top chains to return, 1-100 (default 15)

tools.name: get_crypto_price
tools.description: Current price, 24h change percent, and market cap for one or more cryptocurrencies. Price: $0.001 per call.

tools.name: get_crypto_market_data
tools.description: Rich market data for one or more cryptocurrencies: rank, 24h high/low, volume, all-time high, and more. Price: $0.002 per call.

tools.name: get_crypto_trending
tools.description: The top trending cryptocurrencies right now, ranked by search interest. Price: $0.001 per call.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Real-time web search — ranked results with title, URL, published date, author, and relevance score for a query. Price: $0.003 per call.

tools.name: call_multichain_rpc
tools.description: Safelisted read-only JSON-RPC proxy across Base, Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, and Optimism — eth_call, eth_getBalance, eth_getTransactionReceipt, eth_blockNumber, and more. Write methods (sending transactions, signing) are never permitted. Price: $0.003 per call.

method.description: Read-only JSON-RPC method name, e.g. eth_getBalance, eth_call, eth_blockNumber

params.description: JSON-encoded array of RPC params, e.g. ["0xabc...","latest"] (default [])

tools.name: get_wallet_balance
tools.description: Native token balance for a wallet address, plus an optional specific ERC-20 token balance, across Base, Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, or Optimism. Price: $0.002 per call.

token.description: Optional ERC-20 token contract address to also check

tools.name: get_gas_price
tools.description: Current gas price and EIP-1559 fee estimate for Base, Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, or Optimism. Price: $0.001 per call.

tools.name: resolve_ens
tools.description: Resolves an ENS name to an address, or reverse-resolves an address to its primary ENS name (Ethereum mainnet). Provide exactly one of name or address. Price: $0.002 per call.

address.description: EVM address to reverse-resolve to its primary ENS name
